artwork.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide panoramic hero background for a Fansville-themed college football trivia website. Create original polished cinematic illustrated concept art inspired by Dr Pepper's fictional Fansville football town. Landscape panoramic composition approx 3:1, warm nostalgic Americana, autumn Saturday afternoon golden sunlight. A charming brick Main Street with a red-and-cream diner, clapboard houses, burgundy football pennants, a football stadium with glowing floodlights in the distance, and a tall cream water tower bearing the exact single word 'FANSVILLE' in dark burgundy block lettering on the right half. Tasteful Dr Pepper burgundy #71152D, dark wine #330C18, warm cream #FFF4DD, warm muted red, subtle golden accents, trees with autumn foliage. Put the most interesting town buildings, water tower and stadium in the right two thirds; leave the left third softly atmospheric and less busy for readable website text placed separately in HTML. Premium textured hand-painted realism, crisp architectural details, welcoming and playful, lively small town sports atmosphere. No human close-ups, no celebrities or existing television actors. No UI, no buttons, no frames, no extra text or taglines, no watermarks. This is a new original illustration, not a recreation of a commercial screenshot.
